newsitem.title: USA: Ford won't sell flood-damaged trucks.
newsitem.headline: Ford won't sell flood-damaged trucks.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. said Thursday it had no plans to sell about 2,000 trucks damaged by flooding at the automaker's Louisville, Ky., assembly plant this week.

Ford said in a statement that it will not ship the damaged trucks to dealerships or send them to vehicle auctions. Each of the vehicles are being examined by plant personnel and insurance adjusters to determine whether it should be scrapped.
The Louisville plant, hit by flooding in the Ohio River basin, produces Ford Explorer and Mercury Mountaineer sport utility vehicles and Ford Ranger compact pickup trucks.
The flooding in the plant's parking lot forced Ford to suspend production for part of the day on Monday.
